name: Pudney Internet Solutions
summary: Adelaide web dev (since 1993) + hosting (from 1995) provider (Pudney Pty Ltd, director Phillip Pudney); connected via Chariot (PUDNEY, PHILLIP, ABN 70 179 881 818).

events.details: Defunct. Pudney Internet Solutions vanished between Apr 1999 and Oct 2000 when the domain reverted to Phillip Pudney's personal site — the proposed c. 2016 date mistakes his astronomy content for ISP continuity.

refs.label: By 17 Oct 2000 the domain was the owner's personal homepage (and stayed personal/astronomy through the 2016 ASSA capture), so the ISP brand died in that window.
Current auDA whois (Sep 2026): the ISP's own domain is registered to Phillip Pudney under ABN 70 179 881 818 itself (auDA whois for pudney.net.au)
Site names the same individual and Adelaide; ABN history shows the sole-trader ABN active Mar 2005 - Jul 2024 at SA 5062
